# The BandPilot community on Discord

[Français](COMMUNITY_FR.md) · [English](COMMUNITY_EN.md) · [Italiano](COMMUNITY_IT.md) · [Español](COMMUNITY_ES.md) · [Deutsch](COMMUNITY_DE.md)

A place for musicians to help each other with soundchecks, monitor mixes, rehearsals and recording. All instruments, bands and experience levels are welcome.

**[Join the Discord](https://discord.gg/FtWwEPmwE7)**

Ask questions, share your experience and suggest improvements to BandPilot. Chat in French or English.

### Discord, right inside BandPilot

In the new releases, open “Help and issues” from the menu or Settings: get help in #entraide-help, read the getting-started guide, suggest ideas and report issues in #bugs-tests. The issue message includes the app version; review it, copy it and send it yourself in Discord. No logs or audio are attached automatically.

[Get help](https://discord.com/channels/1570533717917573260/1570534770297806888) · [Report an issue](https://discord.com/channels/1570533717917573260/1570534866049699882)

## Choose a channel

| Channel | What is it for? |
|---|---|
| #accueil-welcome | Welcome, rules and useful links · read only |
| #annonces-news | Releases and guides · read only |
| [#demarrer-start-here](https://discord.com/channels/1570533717917573260/1571098590925955082) | Getting-started guide and first settings |
| #discussion-general | Introductions and conversations between musicians |
| [#entraide-help](https://discord.com/channels/1570533717917573260/1570534770297806888) | Questions, setup and troubleshooting |
| [#idees-feedback](https://discord.com/channels/1570533717917573260/1570534825700368424) | Ideas and user feedback |
| [#bugs-tests](https://discord.com/channels/1570533717917573260/1570534866049699882) | Bugs, testing and preview releases |

A Général voice channel is also available for live conversations.

## Get started

Introduce your band, instrument and use cases. For a technical question, include your mixer, BandPilot version and device. One question or idea per thread makes replies easier.

## A welcoming and useful space

Be respectful and kind; avoid spam and private data. Review screenshots and logs before sharing them. Presets are starting points to adapt to your setup. Help is voluntary, with no guaranteed response time.

Use Discord for conversations. To track a reproducible bug or a specific request over time, also open a GitHub issue. Use the security procedure for vulnerabilities.

[Open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/herve8940/BandPilot/issues/new/choose) · [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/herve8940/BandPilot/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

Discord is an external service that requires a Discord account. Joining is optional: BandPilot works without a Discord account. The website and app load no Discord widget.

Independent project, not affiliated with Behringer, Midas or Music Tribe.
